description: Renovate rather than Dependabot for one reason: Dependabot has no mise ecosystem, so the Rust toolchain in mise.toml would have stayed a pin nobody was watching.

helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests is for the next action somebody adds. One already written as `<sha> # v4` is updated in place either way, comment and all; without the preset an unpinned one stays unpinned and the convention erodes an entry at a time.
JSON carries no comments, so the reasoning lives in these description fields, and at length in docs/decisions.md.

lockFileMaintenance.description: Every job passes --locked, so Cargo.lock is the graph cargo-deny audits and the one CI builds. Left alone it drifts from the registry until some unrelated change forces a large, unreviewable refresh.
schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: One pull request for all of them: these move together, and reviewing nine separate SHA bumps is how a stale pin gets rubber-stamped.
Majors stay ungrouped, so a breaking bump arrives alone and legible rather than buried in a batch CI reports as one red run.
The toolchain is never grouped. A Rust bump can change what clippy rejects and what rustfmt produces, so it needs a run of its own to be attributable.
